cases.name: table-singleton-init-and-member-write
cases.source:
[Config]
    value = 0
    def init(self, int value = 9) -> none
        self.value = value
    def add(self, int amount) -> int
        self.value += amount
        return self.value
answer = Config.add(2)
if answer != 11
    raise ArithmeticError(code = "BAD_SINGLETON")

cases.name: table-instance-isolation-and-method-defaults
cases.source:
[[Counter]]
    _value = 2
    def init(self, int start) -> none
        self._value += start
    def read(self) -> int
        return self._value
    def add(self, int amount = 3) -> int
        self._value += amount
        return self.read()
def result() -> int
    first = new Counter(5)
    second = new Counter(1)
    return first.add() + second.read()

cases.name: table-alias-and-container-drop-once

    def drop(self) -> none

def work() -> none

    alias = first
    items = [alias]
work()
if State.count != 7
